projects.title: IntelliHire
projects.subtitle: AI-Enhanced Personal Data Sheet Parsing System for PESO (Public Employment Service Office)
projects.stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js, Google Gemini 2.0 Flash, Vercel
bullets: Built a MERN stack job portal enabling direct and efficient hiring for PESO Santo Tomas, Batangas, managing job posts, applicant profiles, and recruiter screening data through a shared set of modules.
Developed the frontend in React to deliver quick page loads and clear navigation for both job seekers and recruiters.
Designed the data flow between the parsing engine and the application database to reduce manual screening work for recruiters.
projects.details: Applicants upload their Personal Data Sheet, and the system extracts education, experience, eligibility, and skills automatically. Candidates are ranked with a hybrid score — a configurable eight-criteria PDS score, a rule-based algorithmic score, and an AI evaluation from Gemini 2.0 Flash that returns reasons, strengths, and concerns. Administrators get percentile rankings, status tracking, CSV export, and analytics, and the system can turn a PDS into an ATS-ready resume.

bullets: Developed 5 core modules and 6 additional pages across 2 integrated systems for inventory tracking and biometric attendance.
Built inventory tracking with Firestore and Cloudinary-hosted media, the same kind of product, stock, and image data that online store catalogs depend on.
Implemented face recognition-based attendance logging using face-api.js, hosted on Firebase with full authentication, database, and cloud storage integration.
Integrated Google Gemini AI for anti-spoofing and liveness detection to strengthen the reliability of the facial recognition module.
projects.details: A single web platform that replaced manual records for inventory, attendance, employee administration, and purchasing. Stock levels and item movements update in real time, attendance is verified by face recognition and QR codes, and role-based access makes sure each user only sees the modules their role allows.
